_comment: invrisil_walkthrough's start (FIXTURE-FIRST). Same door-chain/awakening accomplishments as near_riverfarm (door_awakened already banked, standing at the SAME free cell (13,6) facing the awakened pantry_door, moved against the east wall by playtest hotfix #2) PLUS invrisil_attuned -- the Guild-board letter has already been read, so the portal menu offers Invrisil as a real destination the moment this canonical opens it (riverfarm_attuned is deliberately absent, so Riverfarm never enters that filtered list -- the script's own comment traces the resulting 2-destination menu). player_skills carries the SAME QA-fixture-only `sneak`/`observe` grant stealth_loop already established (no shipped class grants sneak this early; a real [Rogue] earn supersedes it later) -- needed to exercise the sneak-positive leg of the alley footpads. `classes: {warrior: 2}` is set DIRECTLY (bypassing gained_by/won_combat -- fixtures may preload state, the near_rogue/near_evolution precedent) to MATCH the combat data's own tuning baseline verbatim: the alley_footpads roster's gated 0.75-0.98 win band (combatants.json's own _comment) was measured at 'warrior2 SOLO' specifically -- a classless L1 PC with a rusty_sword and no combat skills is a materially weaker matchup than that tuned baseline and was confirmed (first attempt) to lose outright at seed 9. known_skills() derives class skills from the `classes` dict dynamically (WIProgression.granted_skills), so warrior2 here correctly fields basic_swordwork/tough_body/power_strike/piercing_strikes/counter_strike/battle_momentum without needing won_combat to have organically fired first. rng_state IS load-bearing here (unlike stealth_loop's own cosmetic seed) since the sneak-negative leg resolves a real fight -- seed 9 was checked against the shipped script and wins cleanly at warrior2.
